# mtg-mcp

> A C# MCP server that gives LLMs grounded Magic: The Gathering card, deck,
> source, and statistical evidence plus safe deck-planning workflows.

Current code, tests, project files, checked-in configuration, and `AGENTS.md`
are authoritative. This file is a compact orientation index, not a second
instruction file.

This branch contains the Phase 3 contracts and configuration foundation of the clean-break rewrite.
The shipped legacy server remains available through Git history and its release,
but its production code is no longer present here. Read
[Rewrite guide](docs/rewrite-guide.md) before treating historical architecture
or public-surface docs as future design requirements.

## Start Here

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository rules, architecture boundaries, safety, planning, and validation.
- [README](README.md): Current foundation status, product direction, and development commands.
- [North star](docs/north-star.md): Product mission, evidence hierarchy, and non-goals.
- [Design goals](docs/design-goals.md): Architecture, quality, testing, and MCP principles.
- [Rewrite guide](docs/rewrite-guide.md): Current-versus-target routing, rewrite guardrails, and implementation entry gate.
- [Rewrite program](docs/llms/plcs/in-progress/evidence-first-mcp-rewrite-program/README.md): Governing `0.9.0` umbrella PLC.
- [Potential features](docs/potential-features.md): Deferred ideas that are not stable rewrite scope.
- [Taskfile](Taskfile.yml): Supported local and CI operations; run `task --list`.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Rewrite target summary plus explicitly labeled legacy implementation reference.

- [Toolsets](docs/toolsets.md): Current legacy tool groups; not the rewrite surface.
- [Output control](docs/output-control.md): Shared summary, normal, and full result levels.
